name: ColocoDX
summary:
ColocoDX (Cosmos Orbital Landing Outer Crash Officer DELUXE) is the expanded edition of the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC video game Coloco, originally released in 2020 by Tuxedo Gamedevs.

The game puts you at the controls of a rescue ship tasked with navigating caves, space facilities, and other harsh environments to locate crash sites, pick up downed pilots, and bring them back to base safe and sound. All the while, you’ll weave through mazes, traps, and enemies, and clear blocked passages using a variety of tools—always managing the ship’s inertia, the true heart of the gameplay.
